newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Asian dollar deposits market is closed from Friday, February 7 to Monday, February 10 for the Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Hari Raya Puasa holidays.
It will reopen on Tuesday, February 11.
On Thursday, in day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday, weekend and week-fixed were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
